reported_context.session_intent: Repeat the prior day's 10-minute warmup, 40-minute steady main block and 10-minute cooldown for a back-to-back comparison.
reported_context.athlete_response: The session felt easier. The same diffuse bilateral muscular burning as the prior day appeared only during the final five minutes of cooldown, reached 8/10 at the final minute and resolved fully after the ride.
reported_context.symptom_classification: Transient bilateral exertional muscular burning in the glutes, matching the 2026-08-26 symptom; not sharp or focal pain. Athlete reported 0/10 at approximately 14:45 local after the session.

session_contract_review.local_leg_symptom: The same diffuse bilateral glute muscular burning as 2026-08-26, occurring only in the final five minutes of cooldown and resolving to 0/10 after the session.
session_contract_review.cardiorespiratory_feel: The session was subjectively easier overall at global RPE 3.
session_contract_review.technical_quality_notes: Indoor seated low-aerobic session; MTB technical fields are not applicable.
session_contract_review.stop_rule_interpretation: Preserve the athlete's explicit not-triggered outcome. The symptom was familiar diffuse muscular burning, not sharp or focal pain, appeared only in the final five minutes of cooldown and resolved completely after the ride.
session_contract_review.fluid_fuel_sodium_and_cooling: 700 ml water and ceiling fan at maximum; pre-session or during-session carbohydrate and sodium were not reported.

objective_session_evidence.source: Garmin activity 24131659432 standard activity, split and detailed trace surfaces

main_block.interpretation_guardrail: The active HR source was not resolved by Garmin standard metadata, so decoupling is supportive rather than definitive evidence.

environment_and_hydration.guardrail: Garmin water loss is modeled rather than measured.

matched_comparison_to_2026_08_26.external_power_dose: Matched: both rides were 60 minutes, 119 W average, 120 W normalized power and IF 0.569; both main blocks averaged 126 W.
matched_comparison_to_2026_08_26.cadence_and_torque: Today's main cadence was 84 versus 76 rpm. At the same 126 W this lowered mean crank-torque demand from approximately 15.8 to 14.3 Nm, about 9.5 percent, shifting work away from force per pedal stroke.
matched_comparison_to_2026_08_26.cardiovascular_cost: Today's average HR was 126 versus 121 bpm, Garmin load 54.3 versus 48.4 and aerobic TE 2.7 versus 2.5. Main-block HR was 130 versus 123 bpm.
matched_comparison_to_2026_08_26.decoupling: Trace-derived main-block HR-per-watt drift improved from approximately 5.6 percent to 3.5 percent, with unresolved HR-source provenance.
matched_comparison_to_2026_08_26.symptom_timing: The posterior-chain symptom was delayed from approximately minute 45 overall on 2026-08-26 to approximately minute 55 on 2026-08-27.
matched_comparison_to_2026_08_26.interpretation: The local improvement is consistent with greater recovery from the 2026-08-25 torque session plus today's higher-cadence, lower-force execution. It is not yet evidence of a 24-hour fitness adaptation, and the higher HR/load means the whole-body cost was not lower.

coach_contract_audit.dose_alignment: The athlete repeated the prior day's external workout but exceeded the current day's planned 20-30 minute 105-120 W recovery primer. This is execution drift relative to the 2026-08-27 written contract.
coach_contract_audit.next_constraint: No additional training today. The resolved bilateral muscular burn does not independently close the next training day; use fresh next-day Garmin and subjective evidence to select the next dose.
